research_question: Does fixed covariance regularization explain density-score sensitivity to coordinate scaling when PCA directions are unchanged?
audit: No active experiment process, local script/result/log, or remote covariance-scaling artifact at session start; previous component report specifies this as future work. No duplicate launched.
population: All250 archived Llama13/Gemma12 system x standard/disjoint x seeds0-4 jobs;100 ordered references including10 synthetic; same strict5-generation labels, fair layers16/21, original selected PCA coordinates. No PCA refit or model-selection change.
anchors: Reuse archived PASS,relative,LR risks and canonical original AUROC. New refits use float64 arithmetic on the exact archived float32 coordinates; compare scaling effects within their own float64 identity fits. Do not describe any identity-refit discrepancy as a regularization gain.
scales: reference_unit_sd:1/population_SD of each PCA coordinate over all100 references
density: Full-covariance k-component PASS and FAIL GMM, original per-job k and lambda. n_init30,max_iter500,tol0.001,seed unchanged. Custom matrix-ridge EM validated against stock sklearn when R=lambda I.

regularizers.fixed: R_D=lambda I in every scaled coordinate system; backmapped ridge=lambda diag(1/D^2)
regularizers.transported: R_D=lambda diag(D^2), the pushforward of the original ridge
regularizers.scale_aware: R_D=alpha diag(Var_reference(ZD)); alpha=lambda/mean(Var_reference(Z)), calibrated once at unscaled reference so mean diagonal ridge at identity equals original lambda. Reference covariates only; no test normalization or tuning. This is diagonal-scale-equivariant, not generally affine-equivariant.

analytic: Transport weights,means,covariances,precision-Cholesky of already fitted identity models. Verify logp_D(Dx)=logp(x)-logdet(D) and relative-density invariance. Include archived original PASS model. No fitting in this branch.
controlled_refits: For each class and each of30 restarts, initialize responsibilities by seeded KMeans on unscaled original reference coordinates. Reuse this exact initialization across all D and R; carry out EM on scaled reference inputs with matrix ridge. This controls KMeans geometry while allowing regularization/EM refitting effects. Identity fixed equals identity transported; fit once and reuse.
native_initialization_diagnostic: For the nonuniform diagonal and unit-SD scalings only, additionally run transported ridge with native scaled-space KMeans initialization. Difference versus transported controlled initialization diagnoses initialization/optimization effects despite a correctly transformed ridge. Bounded diagnostic, no selection of a winning start by outer labels.
LR: Reuse archived same-space LR; additionally refit balanced C1 LogisticRegression with reference-coordinate StandardScaler,random_state=seed,max_iter3000. Positive diagonal scaling cancels through the scaler; verify score/rank stability against identity LR. No new features.
fit_budget: Per job <=28 mixture estimators (30 starts each),5 small LR fits;250 jobs <=7000 mixture estimators/210000 EM restarts,1250 LR fits. Cache identity fits and initial responsibilities;4 CPU processes,OMP/MKL/OpenBLAS1; expected10-40 minutes, pilot runtime recorded before full launch.
metrics: FAIL-positive AUROC,average precision,prevalence; score max absolute and normalized error,Spearman,Kendall,tie-aware pair inversion fraction,top-risk-quintile overlap. Covariance eigenvalues/condition number in scaled and backmapped coordinates, precision residual, convergence,n_iter,lower bound. Save score arrays and fitted parameters.
statistics: Per-seed system macro mean,mean and sample SD of5 seeds. Matched per-system differences;system-cluster bootstrap4000,seed20261112,all5 seeds retained. Fixed versus transported matched refits isolates ridge under fixed initialization. Standard/disjoint gap evaluated on identical input intersections and paired reduction versus identity; absolute disjoint gain required alongside gap interpretation.
validation: Original anchors AUROC tolerance1e-12 against canonical jobs; exact ref/test/label/source hashes. Scalar-matrix EM equivalence to stock within1e-10 normalized score error. Analytic density/Jacobian normalized max error <=1e-8 (normalizer=max(1,abs(expected))); controlled transported/scale-aware refit equivariance normalized max error <=1e-6. Report raw errors and all tie-sensitive rank/metric discrepancies; gates never relaxed. Nonconvergence/SPD failures explicitly recorded, never silently repaired or hidden. Two isolated deterministic job replays. No GT test labels or template IDs used for scales,regularization,init,EM,or selection.
interpretation: Mathematical invariance is not an empirical improvement. A good transported ridge can preserve a poor score. Pure scaling sensitivity does not identify why PCA directions change prediction, and no explanation of the extra unseen penalty without paired shared-input split evidence. No shared-covariance or k-search added to this focused experiment.
